broken.what: After a test session with 4 questions answered and one wrong attempt on Q4, the home page still shows 'History: No sessions yet', 'Dashboard: Nothing secured yet, 0% across all subjects' and 'Error log: All clear'. None of her progress shows outside the Resume card.
broken.step: Student taps Home and leaves the test (17-after-leaving)

broken.what: The 'Revise a topic' card lists 'Biology · Chemistry · Physics · Geography · Sociology' with no Maths, although Maths topics exist and she is doing a Maths test.
Question 3 never gives a unit (no cm in the question), but the input is labelled cm³ and the feedback says '60 cm³'.

looks_wrong.what: The topic-test status line ('Topic test · question N of 10', 'Good — keep going.', 'Not quite. Try again, or tap "I need a hint".') is half hidden under the sticky top bar. Only the bottom of the text shows.
The status/feedback banner is clipped under the sticky header. Only 'again, or tap "I need a hint".' is visible, and the start of the message is hidden.
The status banner is cut to the single word 'going.' because it sits under the sticky header.
The topic page opens scrolled past its title. The 'Algebra' heading and back button are hidden under the header, so only the description line is visible.
The 'Take the topic test →' button is cut off by the bottom edge of the viewport.
The unit 'cm³' sits as a label before the answer box instead of after it. It reads like part of the prompt.

would_quit.quote: Step 2: "Solve: (x + 3)² = 1 → x + 3 = ±1. Find the larger root." — the student gives up here
would_quit.why: Fifth question of ten, a completing-the-square step with no worked example in the test, and nothing on screen says how much is left. She stopped.

fixes.target: Sticky header / topic-test status bar layout
fixes.change: Add top padding or scroll-margin-top equal to the header height so the 'question N of 10' line, feedback banner and topic title render fully below the sticky nav on phone and laptop.
Put 'cm³' after the input box, and add 'lengths in cm' to the question text so the unit in the answer is justified.

fixes.target: Home 'Revise a topic' card subject list
fixes.change: Include Maths in the subject list (e.g. 'Maths · Biology · Chemistry · Physics · Geography · Sociology').
Record the in-progress test: show it in History, update the Algebra 'attempted' count, and log the Q4 step 1 miss in the Error log.
Show marks so far and a clear 'X of 10 questions' progress count next to the question so she can see how close she is to finishing.

checks.what: coming back resumes the same test question
